title: Aerovia model manifest
description: Contract model-manifest 1.0.0: data/models/manifest.json, written by surrogate_export.py and amended by verify-learned-browser.mjs (browser-evidence.json): the identity of every model file. surrogate_validate.py validate_models and frontend/scripts/prepare-data.mjs read it.

files.description: Path relative to data/models to its identity: the registry, the parity fixtures, every checkpoint and ONNX file, and the browser evidence once published; the manifest itself never.
